description: α_EM R2 Quillen-curvature attack (bean qou-jkcx; DERIVATION-ONLY; owner ruling 2026-07-19 stands: R2 NOT proved, 1/(8π) stays phase-4, NOTHING wires). Executes the §5 proposal of the 2026-07-25 Quillen classification: test whether 1/(8π) is a determinant-line CURVATURE coefficient over the Bring Jacobian family Jac(Bring) ≅ E_{5τ}³ × E_τ. Building block (exact): c₁(L_τ) = −(1/2π)·ω_hyp per elliptic factor (AGMV 4.18 × the verified −1/(2y²)); ω_hyp scale-invariant under τ↦5τ so the (3,1) multiplicities pull back cleanly. Candidate table (exact rational × 1/π, no tolerance): unit-multiplicity product 2/π (MISS ×16); isogeny-weights (5,5,5,1) 8/π (MISS ×64); per-real-mode (÷b₁=8) = 1/(4π) = a₀ EXACTLY (MISS ×2 — the Quillen route independently reproduces the derived heat-kernel unit; the residual 2 is the known open ½, #3925); per-mode on the complexified doubled pair (÷16) = 1/(8π) MATCH but the divisor is the R2-core premise itself; Belavin–Knizhnik WP coefficient with scalar content 8/(64π) = 1/(8π) MATCH but n=0 is unforced (photon spin-1 content gives 13/(8π) or 11/(16π), both MISS) and Σ = 4·2 = 2g = b₁ is the count in disguise under AGMV's WP convention. Prune: no integer n has 3(n+1)²−1 = 8. The forced even/Szegő characteristic (A6) is curvature-coefficient-blind (AGMV: S_L, U_WP reference no characteristic) — it cannot carry the 1/8. VERDICT: shape-compatible, selection-dependent — NOT derived; every exact match needs exactly one unforced choice restating R2's known open content. MISMATCH FINDING: R2-core's object is a Schwinger proper-time measure normalization, not a determinant-line quantity; the curvature attack can reproduce a₀ and relocate the ½, not derive it. Scope-(a); NO FIT; audit-only; nothing wired.
